answer: Reputation-weighted work auction. An agent earns a public score from completed tasks, recorded on a shared ledger that acts as a trellis for trust to accumulate. New identities start at zero and must win low-value jobs to build score, while established agents get preferential access to high-value contracts. Each identity also pays a fixed umber registration deposit plus a recurring liveness fee, small but nonzero. To sybil, an attacker clones identities but each clone needs a separate anchor of verified work history and pays the deposit and fees repeatedly,
